prompt: An occupancy dashboard shows 95% while a detail table shows 100 rooms with 3 canceled and 2 refunded records; updates arrive late and one property's data is restricted. Design a trustworthy metric and verification fixture.
rubric: Defines grain, denominator, filters, timezone and freshness; reconciles card/chart/table.
Separates zero, missing, stale and unauthorized data.
Includes fixed fixture and permission/failure acceptance checks.
